Episodes: E1230 (mindcrack: the logo beside the orange, the diplomat in the Dutch Discord), E1231 (formula1: Verstappen asked of the orange), E1232 (indonesia: attack talk both ways, then land given for defence; r/indonesia's record frames its calls through the colonial past), E1233 (ss13: the orange pushing into the logo and the Discord's order to stop), E1234 (ftlgame: one member's rebuild application, as E249), E1235 (albania: the orange space above Norway), E1236 (theblackvoid: the Dutch and the Void; the records differ on the end). Joins, one run: E039 (greyblob), E060 (Greece), E093 (Goodboye), E142 (the Dutch flag, anthem and orange; r/PlaceNL is the planning room), E242 (overwatch), E588 (Dominican), E819 (Czech), E920 (Sweden), E970 (Singapore). E060 and E242 list T3-149, held by none of their rooms before and after the join; left for B1d. Not episodes: corridor (the orange field and Dutch diplomacy in its record only, c0027 there), norge (the late border, c0241 there and c0175 here, no common event shown), europe, theitalyplace, placehearts, ainbowroad (the road Dutch-ified, c1900 there; nothing here), metalgearsolid (c0103 there), archlinux (after the close), and the overlap and border rooms. Puerto Rico has no room in the census. Lead, unread: italy. National and colonial content placed plainly: the colonial framing (VOC mentality, colonising South Africa again, make the Netherlands great again, Greece bought fairly, successful colonisation), the Wilhelmus sung at the close, the king and royal couple, the provincial flags, Indonesia called easy spoils, and r/indonesia's call to strip the blue from the Dutch flag. For B1d, unnamed kinds left out: t03 T3-124 (c0005); t07 T3-151 (c0059, c0060), T3-149 (c0046), T3-195 (c0064), T3-139 (c0079, c0096); t10 T3-077 (c0087, scripted animation); t11 T3-136 (c0040, c0130); t12 T3-009 (c0048, c0220), T3-130 (c0077, c0242); t14 T3-088 (c0213, ten accounts to demolish the Yeti), T3-076 (c0123, c0132), T3-028 (c0125). Nothing left out or softened.
